overview: IP address = network part + host part. Subnet mask/CIDR prefix batata hai kitne bits network ke hain. GATE me 4 kaam: same network check, hosts/subnets count, CIDR block allocation/aggregation, aur routing table me longest prefix match.
whyItMatters: 21 PYQs, 2003-2025 me lagatar; routing-table aur mask calculation har 2-3 saal me aata hai.
coreConcept: Network address = IP AND mask. Do addresses same network me hain agar dono ka (IP AND mask) barabar ho. Forwarding me longest matching prefix jeetta hai.
hinglishExplanation: Mask me jitne 1 bits hain wo network hain, baaki 0 bits host hain. Host bits h ho to total addresses 2^h, usable hosts 2^h - 2 (all-0 = network address, all-1 = broadcast). Subnet banane par host bits me se kuch bits network me chale jaate hain.
formalDefinition: For prefix /n: host bits = 32 - n; addresses per block = 2^(32-n); usable hosts = 2^(32-n) - 2.
importantProperties: Network id = IP AND mask; broadcast = network id OR (NOT mask).
Subnets = 2^s jahan s = borrowed bits (GATE me kabhi all-0/all-1 subnet bhi allowed maani jaati hai; question ke hisaab se).
Class A /8, Class B /16, Class C /24.
CIDR block ka size power of 2 hona chahiye aur start address block-size ke multiple par align hona chahiye.
Longest prefix match: routing table me sabse bada matching prefix wali entry chuni jaati hai; default route 0.0.0.0/0.
Aggregation: kai prefix ko ek chhote prefix (bada block) me jod sakte ho jab wo contiguous aur aligned hon.
Variable-length subnets: bade requirement wale ko pehle allocate karo.
Same subnet ke hosts ko router ki zaroorat nahi; alag subnet me default gateway chahiye.
keyPropertiesAndIdentities: Prefix /n me last non-255 octet ka block size = 2^(8 - (n mod 8)).
commonPitfalls: -2 lagana bhool jaana (ya galat jagah lagana).
Longest prefix ki jagah pehli matching entry le lena.
Broadcast ko host address maan lena.
standardTechniques: Interesting octet lo: block size = 256 - mask octet; address kis block me hai nikaalo.
Routing: har prefix ke saath destination AND karo, matching ko compare karo, longest prefix chuno.
Variable subnet allocation: size ko next power of 2 par round up karo.
